title: ship.config.json
description: Per-repo configuration for the ship-harness plugin.

tracker.description: Where ticket state lives. 'none' keeps it in .evidence/status.md.

testPaths.description: Globs the phase guard freezes during the review and fix phases. Set these to match your ecosystem — the defaults only cover the common cases.

attribution.description: Whether generated PR bodies and status comments carry an AI-assistance footer.

setup.description: Written once the user has confirmed the loop budgets. The ship and review skills refuse to run until confirmedAt is set, because a budget nobody chose is a default nobody owns.

confirmedAt.description: ISO date the caps were confirmed. null means never confirmed.

autonomy.description: Whether a ship run stops at the plan for a human signature, or drives the ticket to a PR on its own. `goal` still commits the plan as the contract — it self-approves and says so in the commit message — and still stops for the irreversible, out-of-scope and unresolved-disagreement cases.

caps.description: Loop budgets. You set these at init and confirm them before first use. 0 means no fixed cap: the loop runs until a round produces no new findings. A count is a blunt instrument — it stops a loop that is still making progress and lets one that is going in circles run to the limit — so the convergence rule is the real termination criterion either way.

reviewers.description: Model tier per review round. Two different models is the point; collapsing them to one removes the independence the second round exists for.

memoryCaps.description: Hard line caps on docs/memory. Adding is easy and removing takes judgement, so without a cap you get a file nobody trusts within two months.

env.description: How to tell when this repo's environment is serving. A readiness predicate only — the harness waits for it, it never starts anything.

ready.description: Shell command; success means the environment is serving. With an on-demand sandbox, connecting is also what wakes it.

readyTimeout.description: Seconds to wait before reporting the run BROKEN.

collectors.description: Evidence collectors, run in order by scripts/collect.sh.

cmd.description: Any executable obeying collectors/CONTRACT.md. Mutually exclusive with 'kind'.

config.description: Passed to the collector verbatim as the SHIP_COLLECTOR_CONFIG environment variable.
